I replied to Marcus in the #north-random thread to confirm his correction: the deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is 15 August, as their ops lead told him. He asked for no action, so I didn't do anything else.

His message is the record. The workspace saves channel messages as they're posted, so I didn't add a separate note. The deadline is a date, not a money term, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
